description: The plot titled "The performance on Llama2" displays the accuracy (ACC) percentage on the y-axis, which ranges from 60% to 80%. The x-axis represents the co-occurrence number, ranging from 10^1 to 10^3. There are five lines representing different methods: Base (black line), MEND (red line), MEMIT (purple line), FT (blue line), and IKE (green line). The Base line starts at approximately 70% accuracy at the lowest co-occurrence number and ends around 75% at the highest co-occurrence number. The MEND line starts at around 65% and ends near 70%. The MEMIT line begins at about 60% and rises to approximately 65%. The FT line starts at around 65% and ends near 70%. The IKE line begins at about 60% and ends around 65%. All lines show a general upward trend, indicating an increase in accuracy with higher co-occurrence numbers.
